title: GameCreate
responsibility: Create an app or dimensional game through the local host and open its resulting workspace.

inputs.name: GameCreate.bridge
inputs.description: Local desktop host operations for project creation, persistence and explicit image generation.

inputs.name: GameCreate.created
inputs.description: Optional callback receiving the created project snapshot instead of full-page navigation.

outputs.name: GameCreate
outputs.description: Create an app or dimensional game through the local host and open its resulting workspace. Renders reactive UI and publishes edits through its callbacks.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Creation or navigation cannot continue when the created game snapshot lacks its project identity.
